text: Experiment 11 (2026-11-11), the experiment 9/10 mocks recovered on rest 4074.5–4666.1 Å, 90 fits, true slope −5.24 Gyr per unit redshift. Recovered slope [95% cluster bootstrap], ratio to truth, median [α/Fe] bias: C1 (no injection, plain grid) −4.54 [−5.53, −3.29], 0.87, +0.02; C2 (C/Fe +0.15, N/Fe +0.30 injected, plain grid) −4.08 [−5.82, −2.49], 0.78, −0.16; C3 (same injection, C and N free) −3.55 [−4.44, −1.86], 0.68, +0.03. Median age bias +0.73 Gyr (C1), +0.96 to +1.10 (C2), +0.51 to +0.69 (C3). M8_161113 covers the window only partly (1490 fitted pixels) and is kept. Comparison with the real 110 galaxies on the same window (experiment 5): plain grid real −4.60 [−5.56, −3.60, 16–84] against C1 −4.54 for a true −5.24; C and N free real −5.37 [−6.29, −4.41] against C3 −3.55. Lead check: slopes recomputed from slope-mismatch/experiment11-per-mock.csv.
